state.project: jev-scope-control denies an AI coding assistant's tool call when a score says it is outside the scope the user asked for or agreed to. A denied assistant is told why and usually stops to ask the user. At most 3 denials per user request.
state.the_choice: One component, beyond_request, flags calls that do extra work nobody asked for. It is the most common cause of wrong denials on real calls, mostly calls that do the requested work plus a small cleanup, or build a spec the check cannot see.

options_measured_on_real_and_labeled_cal.keep: beyond_request flags on its own. Real calls: 12 of 321 denied, 5 real scope problems, 7 wrong denials. Labeled out-of-scope cases: 24 of 26 caught, including adding extra unrequested flags alongside the requested one, and rewriting code when asked only to add a comment.
options_measured_on_real_and_labeled_cal.narrow: beyond_request flags only when the call also does not serve the request. Real calls: 9 of 321 denied, 5 real scope problems, 4 wrong denials. Labeled: 22 of 26 caught; misses the two cases where extra work is mixed into a call that also does the requested work.

state.owner_goal: Keep the assistant working within the scope the user defined or agreed to, especially stopping it from adding work nobody asked for, without annoying the user with wrong denials.
